name: Fadhlina Sidek
_note: M2 cohort expansion (key figures): Minister of Education since the unity government formed (3 Dec 2022). Objective spine plus a provisional Layer B pass on file; below ranking validity pending remaining objective dimensions and an independent Layer B panel. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. The only court matters located are ones she initiated as plaintiff (a defamation suit resolved 20 Apr 2026 by consent judgment and apology in her favour), not matters against her integrity. Recorded as the subject's own factual status only.

citation.title: Jasin MP, Harakah apologise to Fadhlina for making defamatory statements

metrics.justification: Shapley-Shubik power index of the leader's coalition (Pakatan Harapan) among the seven blocs of the 222-seat Dewan Rakyat (GE15, simple-majority quota 112), computed by scripts/compute-pivotality.mjs. PH=0.4048, PN=BN=0.2214, GPS=0.0714. Coalition-level because per-party tallies carry a 1-2 seat contradiction immaterial to the index. Descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

citation.title: GE15 Dewan Rakyat composition (post Padang Serai by-election): PH 82, PN 74, BN 30, GPS 23, GRS 6, Warisan 3, others 4
citation.publisher: Election Commission of Malaysia result, full GE15 seat tally via Free Malaysia Today

metrics.justification: Handling of the death of Zara Qairina Mahathir, 13, near a school hostel (died 17 Jul 2025): announced CCTV, safety audits and a reform committee and demanded the bullying investigation be expedited, but the substantive escalation (inquest, charges) was driven by the Attorney-General's Chambers and she was criticised for not answering Dewan Rakyat questions on the case. A procedural, communications-led response with mixed outcomes (anchor 2).

citation.title: AGC orders inquest into Zara Qairina's death to determine possible criminal elements

metrics.justification: Held the UPSR/PT3 examination abolition against reversal pressure and consolidated school-based assessment (confirmed 11 Nov 2024), but the underlying abolition predated her tenure, and anti-bullying legislation remained at the proposal/review stage (coordinated by the law ministry) rather than gazetted within the window. Partial (anchor 2).

citation.title: Fadhlina rules out return of UPSR, PT3 exams

metrics.justification: Established a special task force to scrutinise dilapidated-school development (9 Mar 2023) and reported 693 of 1,069 dilapidated schools repaired (26 Jan 2024). A standing mechanism with reported output, but durability beyond a task force is not documented (anchor 2).

citation.title: Over half of 1,069 dilapidated schools nationwide repaired, says Fadhlina

metrics.justification: On the UASA passing-grade controversy (Dec 2024) the public explanation came primarily from the Education Director-General rather than a clear on-record account by the minister, and teachers and parents urged the ministry to clarify. A reframing with explanation delegated, not a clean reversal owned on the record (anchor 2).

citation.title: Explain drop in school-based exam passing grade, ministry urged
